tmp=$(mktemp -d) && cat > "$tmp/robust.py" <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, f_classif
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

def load(p):
    t = np.loadtxt(p, delimiter=",", skiprows=1)
    return t[:, :-1], t[:, -1]
Xp, yp = load("data/pilot.csv")
Xh, yh = load("data/heldout.csv")

def pipe(seed, ntrees=1000):
    return make_pipeline(SelectKBest(f_classif, k=25),
                         RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=ntrees, random_state=seed, n_jobs=-1))

print("(1) K=25 default-RF1000, pilot 5-fold cv across fold seeds:")
for s in (0, 1, 2, 3, 4):
    aucs = cross_val_score(pipe(s), Xp, yp, cv=StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=s), scoring="roc_auc")
    print(f"    fold-seed {s}: {aucs.mean():.4f}  folds {np.round(aucs,3)}")

print("(2) final fit on all 400 pilot -> heldout, across tree seeds:")
for s in (0, 1, 2):
    m = pipe(s).fit(Xp, yp)
    print(f"    tree-seed {s}: holdout {roc_auc_score(yh, m.predict_proba(Xh)[:, 1]):.4f}")
EOF
uv run python "$tmp/robust.py"
